analysis.insight_summary: Users face issues where the [product_name] device's IP address is configured and visible on the network, but it is not detected by [product_name] software. Although the device responds to network pings and appears in other network tools, data exchange through [product_name] software fails. This points to possible version incompatibility between the device and software, and clearer guidance during setup or troubleshooting is needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] device to be automatically detected and recognized by [product_name] software when it is correctly configured and reachable on the network using standard IP tools.
